SELECT o.opsregistry, t.deliverysuccessrate, t.avgdeliveryhours, t.distributionpoints, d.invaccpct, 
       (t.deliverysuccessrate/100.0) * (1 - t.avgdeliveryhours/24.0) * (1 + t.distributionpoints/10.0) AS oeisc
FROM operations o
JOIN transportation t ON o.opsdistref = t.transportdistref AND o.opshubref = t.transporthubref
JOIN distributionhubs d ON o.opshubref = d.hubregistry
LIMIT 5;

SELECT o.opsregistry, t.deliverysuccessrate, t.avgdeliveryhours, t.distributionpoints, d.invaccpct, 
       ROUND(CAST((t.deliverysuccessrate/100.0) * (1 - t.avgdeliveryhours/24.0) * (1 + t.distributionpoints/10.0) AS numeric), 2) AS oeisc
FROM operations o
JOIN transportation t ON o.opsdistref = t.transportdistref AND o.opshubref = t.transporthubref
JOIN distributionhubs d ON o.opshubref = d.hubregistry
WHERE t.deliverysuccessrate > 90 AND d.invaccpct > 95
ORDER BY oeisc DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT o.opsregistry AS operation_id, 
       ROUND(CAST((t.deliverysuccessrate/100.0) * (1 - t.avgdeliveryhours/24.0) * (1 + t.distributionpoints/10.0) AS numeric), 2) AS performance_efficiency_score,
       CASE WHEN t.deliverysuccessrate > 90 AND d.invaccpct > 95

            THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS meets_excellence_criteria
FROM operations o
JOIN transportation t ON o.opsdistref = t.transportdistref AND o.opshubref = t.transporthubref
JOIN distributionhubs d ON o.opshubref = d.hubregistry
ORDER BY performance_efficiency_score DESC;

SELECT o.opsregistry AS operation_id, 
       ROUND(CAST((t.deliverysuccessrate/100.0) * (1 - t.avgdeliveryhours/24.0) * (1 + t.distributionpoints/10.0) AS numeric), 2) AS performance_efficiency_score,
       CASE WHEN t.deliverysuccessrate > 90 AND d.invaccpct > 95

       CAST(de.impactmetrics->'population'->>'affected' AS integer) AS people_affected

JOIN distributionhubs d ON o.opshubref = d.hubregistry
JOIN disasterevents de ON o.opsdistref = de.distregistry
ORDER BY performance_efficiency_score DESC;
